title: Sprint-aligned launch cadence: gating matrix and automated release readiness checks for runtime/console/api
creator: Maya Patel
description: Create a repeatable, sprint-aligned launch cadence that coordinates runtime, Console, and API releases across multiple teams. Deliverables: a gating matrix (who signs off on what and when), CI-based readiness checks that fail fast, a lightweight communication/playbook for on-call and PagerDuty handoffs, and an automated dry-run procedure before production windows. Aim to reduce cross-product launch regressions and emergency rollbacks by establishing deterministic gates tied to measurable signals.
objectives: Map each release stage to an owner and exact acceptance signal (unit, integration, perf, infra smoke)
Automate pre-release readiness checks in CI so blocking issues surface at merge time, not during canary
Align release windows to sprint boundaries for runtime/console/api teams to simplify coordination and increase predictability
Tie gating outcomes to OKRs: target 50% fewer post-release incidents for coordinated releases in Q4
acceptance_criteria: Gating matrix published in Confluence and linked from each product repo
At least 4 CI readiness checks implemented and green for test releases: contract, perf-benchmark, KV-cache sanity, roll-forward smoke
Dry-run executed for one full release train (runtime + console + api) with checklist items marked and at most 2 blocked gates resolved before production window
Rollback and fallback steps documented and tested in staging; runbook accessible from Console release dashboard
rollout_plan: Week 1: Cross-functional working session to iterate gating matrix and sign ownership (PM/ENG/DES/SRE)
Week 2: Implement CI readiness checks (automation tasks split across ENG squads), add status badges to PRs
Week 3: Pilot dry-run for a minor runtime patch + console UI toggle to validate coordination and timing
Week 4: Incorporate feedback, finalize communications playbook, schedule first coordinated production window
Post-release: 1-week postmortem and measurement against OKR metrics; capture failures and update matrix
checklist: API contract freeze date set and communicated
End-to-end smoke tests (runtime -> console -> API) pass in staging
Performance regression <10% compared to baseline for critical paths
SLO regressions monitored and alerted with runbook links
Dedicated on-call for release window assigned and paged test successful
Release notes and migration guidance drafted and reviewed
Automated rollback tested in staging (DB schema compatibility not required)
Legal/compliance checklist confirmed for customers on private deployments

2025-10-01 - Planning update: Decision to pair the first dry-run with minor console toggle release to limit blast radius. Added rollout checklist and assigned pre-release owners. Next milestone: CI readiness green by 2025-10-14
notes: Trade-offs: a strict gating matrix increases predictability but can slow feature velocity; mitigation is to offer feature-flagged canaries within a single product boundary and to automate non-blocking signals. Decided not to require a full KMS rotation before minor releases to avoid blocking Dedicated customers; instead added a targeted checklist item for sensitive releases. Security review queued and required for any release touching private deployments.
